refnamediv.refpurpose: Reboot the machine during a maintenance window.

refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: To avoid that a whole cluster or a set of machines with the same task reboot at the same time, rebootmgrd reboots the machine following configured policies.

refsect2.title: Reboot Strategies
refsect2.para: rebootmgr supports various strategies for determining when a reboot should be performed:

listitem.para: The reboot is carried out without waiting for a maintenance window.
Reboot only during a specific maintenance window. If no maintenance window is specified, the system reboots immediately.
This is the default setting. If a maintenance window is specified, maint-window is used. If no maintenance window is specified, the reboot takes place immediately (instantly).

rebootmgr continues to run, but ignores all reboot timers that expire in the meantime. The configuration file is not updated, so this option is no longer active after a reboot. When rebootmgr is reactivated, it will continue to use the old specified maintenance window and any reboot timers that are still running will no longer be ignored.
Reboots will be enabled again. Existing reboot timers will be executed again. Elapsed timers will not be restarted.

refsect2.para: The reboot strategy can be configured via rebootmgr.conf5 and adjusted at runtime via rebootmgrctl1. These changes will be written to the configuration file and survive the next reboot. Except for the off strategy.

listitem.para: Log additional informations during runtime. A real reboot is not done in debug mode.
Log additional informations about requested reboots.
